summary: The Joint Master of Arts in Public Policy (Mundus MAPP) is an Erasmus Mundus joint master's in public policy coordinated with Central European University. It is aimed at Master's applicants. Those who apply by the scholarship deadline are automatically considered for merit-based scholarships.
highlights: Erasmus Mundus joint master's in public policy, coordinated with Central European University.
Applicants who submit by the scholarship deadline are automatically considered for merit-based scholarships.
No application fee for Mundus MAPP applicants, unless also applying to other CEU programs.
